note: Discovery channels ordered by RESPONSE PROBABILITY, not volume (brave-search evidence 2026-08-11: senior AI architects are found via passive outreach on GitHub/arXiv/HuggingFace + communities, not job boards; consulting clients come from expert networks + community reputation, not cold apply). competition 0=none (inbound) .. 1=firehose (cold ATS). The response ranker rewards low competition, warm path, and fresh triggers; cold ATS is coverage-only.
